{{Quote|Lt. Ma'w'shiye's betrayal at Sanjin cost us more lives and equipment than any other operation its size, and his attempts on his former partners are disgusting.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="AJ4" />}}
'''Sanjin''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Sanjin was a blue-green [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] surrounded by habitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="AJ7" /><ref name="TCWEG" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Neebo/Legends|Neebo]] went on a [[Mission to the moons of Sanjin/Legends|mission]] to the moons of Sanjin to defend refugees.<ref name="TCWEG" /> She went missing during the mission, and her [[Neebo's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was later [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|found]] by Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in the [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]].<ref name="LoG">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sanjin was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AJ4" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] on a [[Mission to Sanjin|mission]] to Sanjin. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ma'w'shiye]], a decorated veteran of countless Rebel missions, was part of the operation.<ref name="AJ4" />

For unknown reasons, Ma'w'shiye betrayed his squadron and stole the team's escape [[Starship/Legends|craft]]. His heartless desertion resulted in the immediate execution by the Empire of eleven Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agents]] integral to Alliance activities near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Ma'w'shiye's betrayal was expensive to the Alliance, as it costed more lives and equipment than any other operation its size.<ref name="AJ4" />
